description: Drought_Hazard_Index is a hazard data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by SCIDA. A drought hazard index (DHI) quantifies the likelihood and severity of drought conditions in a specific area, often based on precipitation patterns and other factors. It is a component of drought risk assessment used to estimate the potential impact of drought on ecosystems and societies. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher SCIDA. The portal shows 2025-07-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
